info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account InstantTest API
Runs a new instant test based on the POST data.

params.name: onDemand
params.description: Used to run the instant test on public nodes

items.docs:
Use the onDemand parameter to run from public nodes. An instant test can run from up to five nodes.

**Request:**

The request body must include all required test properties and may include any optional properties as well. By default, the endpoint only allows instant tests to run from enterprise nodes.

To get a sample payload, refer InternalLink[Instant Test Configuration Endpoint,operations-tag-InstantTest,operations-InstantTest-get_v2_instanttests_configuration__instantTestId_].

info.name: Returns properties of one instant test based on instant test ID.

params.name: instantTestId
params.description: Instant test ID to look up the test results. Pass “0” to get post data for creating a new instant test.

items.docs: Results include all the properties set in the instant test during creation. The response from this request can be used to trigger new instant test runs using the POST method.

info.name: Return instant test results performance data based on an instant test ID and node ID.

params.name: instantTestId
params.description: Instant test ID to look up the test results

params.name: nodeId
params.description: Node ID to look up the test results

params.name: stepId
params.description: Step ID to look up the test results

items.docs:
*[Analytics Endpoint]*

Performance data is for one node and a single step. To get transactions data with multiple steps, use the parameter step ID. If no step ID is passed, the endpoint pulls data for the first step.
